open_questions: Rule 'gigs out-earn routine hand trade' is checked by arithmetic only; owner to verify by hand in a run.
handoff: Boost trimmed, gig cash and rush premium raised so hand play pays in gigs. gigs.json unchanged.

flagship_boost_mult.why: boosted round trip 1.25 cycles: hand trade 16 units/cycle, below one lane ship (20), so a lane of 2+ ships always beats routine hand trade (hold 20, 24 and 30 with wings 1a/3a, still under cargo 40)

flagship_boost_charges.why: boost covers part of a leg run, not all

flagship_boost_refill_cycles.why: slower refill keeps boost a line-choice skill

gig_cash_small.why: a signal earns more per Flagship cycle than routine hand trade (about 220/cycle)

gig_rush_premium_pct.why: a rush (about 20 units at 25 value) pays sale plus 60 percent premium, about 250 over routine, plus need credit: hand play pays in gigs

details.sim: not run (owner instruction: no sim, bots or QA). Numbers reasoned by hand: a lane ship moves 20 units/cycle (cargo 40, 2-cycle round trip), margin about 14/unit, trip cost 60.
